    {%- comment -%}
      Accessibility (2026-10-13): owner-approved micro-changes ("Micro-schimbări care duc Accesibilitatea la 100", approved by the owner on 2026-10-13, phones first). Each rule is the smallest change that makes the Lighthouse/axe check pass; everything else on the page stays pixel-identical.
      1. "În stoc" text and icon: #00a341 -> #007f2b (contrast 2.92 -> 4.53 on #f0f0f0, 3.33 -> 5.16 on white). Scoped to variant-inventory, so the theme Success colour (success banners, pickup availability) is unchanged.
      2. Judge.me carousel reviewer names: opacity .6 -> .613 (#707070 -> #6d6d6d on #f0f0f0, 4.34 -> 4.54). Two classes, so this wins over the Judge.me stylesheet that loads later in the body; the app's gallery-theme rule (opacity 1) still wins where it applies.
      3. Blog comment form labels: opacity .5 -> .613 (#858585 -> #6d6d6d on #f0f0f0, 3.23 -> 4.54). Comment form only: the footer newsletter label is white on #1a1a1a and already passes.
      4. Footer ANPC logos: object-fit: contain keeps the logos' real proportions when the row is narrower than the logos (phones). The boxes keep their size, so nothing around them moves; on desktop, where the logos already have their real proportions, nothing changes.
      5. Product gallery dots (shown below 1000px): gap 16px -> 18px, so neighbouring dots are 24px apart (WCAG 2.5.8 target spacing). The max-width + :has() rules keep 16px when the wider row would no longer fit on one line (e.g. 14 dots on screens narrower than 406px), so the dots never wrap onto a second row where they did not before.
      The button red (#ec1e24 -> #e91d23, contrast 4.39 -> 4.50) is set in the theme settings and in the index/product templates, not here.
    {%- endcomment -%}

Lazy-load the two previous/next article card images below the article body by passing position: 4 to blog-post-card (its existing rule: position > 3 => loading="lazy"). Invisible: the cards are below the whole article, and the browser fetches lazy images about 1250 px before they enter the viewport, so the same image appears in the same place (full-page screenshots after scrolling: 0 differing pixels on ce-este-intra-workout and glutamina-beneficii at 412 px; on desktop 1350 px the only difference is row y=136, which also differs between two identical baseline runs). Effect: removes ~60 KB of Medium-priority image downloads from the start of every article page, where they competed with the LCP banner image. Lantern A/B, 3 pairs: article LCP 4540/4778/4051 ms -> 3926/4318/3798 ms; FCP unchanged. Expected on the stg4 mobile report: LCP ~3.98 s -> ~3.45-3.75 s, Performance 48 -> ~50-52. The output equals Shopify image_tag with loading: 'lazy' (attribute inserted before class); no other caller of blog-post-card changes. Staging checksum of the file before the edit: cc98ca7d3c149ace8b2f0c6c0b118c9c (verified read-only via Admin GraphQL).

description: Open the mobile/desktop carousel directly on the selected variant image (scroll-initial-target)
old: <div class="product-gallery__media {% if media.alt contains '@expand' %}product-gallery__media--expand{% endif %} {% if section.settings.mobile_carousel_control != 'free_scroll' %}snap-center{% endif %}" data-media-type="{{ media.media_type }}" data-media-id="{{ media.id }}" {% if filtered_indexes contains media.position %}hidden{% endif %}>
new:
{%- comment -%}
            Performance (2026-10-13; only the loading sequence changes, the page after loading is identical): when the selected
            variant's image is not the first image, the gallery first paints image 1 and the theme script then jumps to the variant's image (on a slow
            phone image 1 is on screen for about a second). scroll-initial-target opens the carousel directly on the variant's image
            (Chrome/Edge 133+, other browsers keep the script jump), so the page after loading is identical, image 1 no longer flashes,
            and the largest paint (LCP) happens at the first paint. Only for carousel layouts, where the media list always scrolls.
          {%- endcomment -%}
          <div class="product-gallery__media {% if media.alt contains '@expand' %}product-gallery__media--expand{% endif %} {% if section.settings.mobile_carousel_control != 'free_scroll' %}snap-center{% endif %}" data-media-type="{{ media.media_type }}" data-media-id="{{ media.id }}" {% if filtered_indexes contains media.position %}hidden{% endif %}{% if media == default_media and media.position > 1 and section.settings.desktop_media_layout contains 'carousel' %} style="scroll-initial-target: nearest"{% endif %}>
